title: Count Good Cyclic Rotations
summary: Given an even-length integer array, count the number of cyclic rotations where the sum of the first half of the array is strictly greater than the sum of the second half.
statement: Given an even-length integer array, count the number of cyclic rotations where the sum of the first half of the array is strictly greater than the sum of the second half.
constraints: For each cyclic rotation, compare the sum of its first half with its second half.
Return the number whose first-half sum is strictly larger.
hints: Maintain the two half sums while shifting the rotation start.
Move the outgoing first value to the second half and the crossing midpoint value to the first.
Update both sums in O(1) and test strict inequality for every rotation.
The updates preserve the exact partition of each rotated array into equal halves.
editorial: The updates preserve the exact partition of each rotated array into equal halves.

tests.explanation: Three of the six rotations have a larger first-half sum.
Both rotations tie, so neither is good.
